theory.summary:
**Reporting Verbs**
Dicen la actitud o intención de quien habló, más allá de say / tell.
Verbo + to-infinitive: agree, offer, promise, refuse, threaten → He refused to answer.
Verbo + persona + to-infinitive: advise, persuade, remind, convince, encourage, invite → The doctor advised me to rest. Negativo: advised me not to…
Verbo + -ing: suggest, deny, admit, recommend, regret → She denied stealing the files.
Verbo + preposición + -ing: apologize for, insist on, accuse someone of → They accused him of lying.
Admit / claim / explain / insist también van con that + oración: He admitted that he had made a mistake.

decks.name: Reporting Verbs
decks.description: Los 3 grupos: verb + to-inf, verb + persona + to-inf, verb + -ing.

cards.en: Adrian offered to make dinner.
cards.es: Adrian ofreció hacer la cena.

cards.en: Pablo promised to tidy his room.
cards.es: Pablo prometió ordenar su cuarto.

cards.en: The children refused to go to bed.
cards.es: Los chicos se negaron a ir a dormir.

cards.en: Sam's neighbour threatened to call the police.
cards.es: El vecino de Sam amenazó con llamar a la policía.

cards.en: Bill advised me to keep my money in the bank.
cards.es: Bill me aconsejó guardar la plata en el banco.

cards.en: Molly reminded Jack to phone the electrician.
cards.es: Molly le recordó a Jack que llamara al electricista.

cards.en: Peter invited me to have dinner.
cards.es: Peter me invitó a cenar.

cards.en: The boss persuaded Megan not to leave.
cards.es: El jefe convenció a Megan de no irse.

cards.en: Ryan suggested going for a walk.
cards.es: Ryan sugirió ir a caminar.

cards.en: Ruby denied eating the chocolates.
cards.es: Ruby negó haber comido los chocolates.

cards.en: Roger apologized for forgetting my birthday.
cards.es: Roger se disculpó por olvidarse de mi cumpleaños.

cards.en: The teacher accused Simon of copying Anna's exam.
cards.es: El profe acusó a Simon de copiarse del examen de Anna.

cards.en: The suspect denied committing the robbery.
cards.es: El sospechoso negó haber cometido el robo.

cards.en: She promised to send the contract before the end of the day.
cards.es: Prometió mandar el contrato antes de que termine el día.

cards.en: The analyst suggested investing in renewable energy.
cards.es: El analista sugirió invertir en energías renovables.

cards.en: They accused the former employee of leaking data to the press.
cards.es: Acusaron al ex empleado de filtrar datos a la prensa.

cards.en: The doctor advised him to take a few days off work.
cards.es: El médico le aconsejó que se tomara unos días en el trabajo.

cards.en: He admitted that he had made a mistake on the form.
cards.es: Admitió que había cometido un error en el formulario.

cards.en: The landlord threatened to evict the tenants.
cards.es: El dueño amenazó con desalojar a los inquilinos.

cards.en: She apologized for arriving late to the meeting.
cards.es: Pidió disculpas por llegar tarde a la reunión.

cards.en: The manager encouraged the team to apply for the award.
cards.es: El gerente alentó al equipo a postularse al premio.

cards.en: Marcos insisted on paying for the coffee.
cards.es: Marcos insistió en pagar el café.

questions.prompt: Completa: 'Bill advised me ____ my money in the bank.'
questions.explanation: advise + persona + to + verbo: Bill advised me to keep my money in the bank.

questions.prompt: Completa: 'Ella insistió en que había un error.' → 'She _______ that there was a mistake.'
Completa: 'Él negó haber robado nada.' → 'He _______ stealing anything.'
questions.explanation: deny + -ing expresa negación; refuse + to + verbo expresa rechazo.

questions.prompt: ¿Qué oración usa correctamente say o tell para comunicarle algo a una persona?
options: She told the news to I.
She said to me about the news.
questions.explanation: En esta construcción: tell someone something; say something to someone. Por ejemplo: She said hello to me.

questions.prompt: Completa el pasado del verbo claim (afirmar): 'She _______ that she saw the accident.'
Reescribe con deny: '"I didn't take your wallet," said James.' → 'James denied ____ my wallet.'
Reescribe con remind: 'Sarah's mother said: "Don't forget: lock the door!"' → 'Her mother reminded her ____ the door.'
Reescribe con insist on: '"I'll pay for the coffee," said Marcos.' → 'Marcos insisted on ____ for the coffee.'
Reescribe con advise: '"You should eat less processed food," the doctor told me.' → 'The doctor advised me ____ less processed food.'
Reescribe con refuse: '"I will not reveal the password," said the candidate.' → 'The candidate refused ____ the password.'
Elige la opción correcta: 'The police officer advised us ____ late at night in that area.'
questions.explanation: Negativo: advise + persona + not to + verbo.

questions.prompt: Elige la opción correcta: 'She apologized ____ ruining the surprise party.'
Elige la opción correcta: 'The investigator suggested ____ the CCTV footage.'
Elige la opción correcta: 'They accused the technician ____ damaging the server.'
Elige la opción correcta: 'He promised ____ the documents as soon as he arrived.'
Traduce: 'La médica me aconsejó que descansara tres días.'
questions.correct: The doctor advised me to rest for three days
variations: The doctor advised me to rest for three days
The doctor advised me to rest for 3 days
The doctor advised me to rest three days

questions.prompt: Traduce: 'Mi colega me recordó que mandara el mail antes del mediodía.'
questions.correct: My colleague reminded me to send the email before noon
variations: My colleague reminded me to send the email before noon
My colleague reminded me to send the e-mail before noon
